sh_better_ui.panel.enabled.tooltip: Toggle backdrop blur in the preview.

sh_better_ui.panel.radius.tooltip: Adjust how far the backdrop blur samples.
sh_better_ui.panel.strength.tooltip: Adjust how strongly the glass effect blends with the original.
sh_better_ui.panel.tint.tooltip: Adjust the amount of glass tint.
sh_better_ui.panel.grain.tooltip: Adjust the intensity of the glass grain.
sh_better_ui.panel.saturation.tooltip: Adjust the color saturation of the backdrop. At 0%, only the tint adds color.
sh_better_ui.panel.lift.tooltip: Add brightness to the glass backdrop.
sh_better_ui.panel.rim.tooltip: Adjust the strength of the light along glass edges.
sh_better_ui.panel.refraction.tooltip: Adjust how far the glass edge distorts the backdrop.
sh_better_ui.panel.contrast.tooltip: Use stronger outlines and solid backgrounds in SHBUI's default controls.
sh_better_ui.panel.theme.group.tooltip: Cycle settings groups. Stage edits before changing groups.
sh_better_ui.panel.theme.json.tooltip: Enter a JSON object. Set only the fields to override. An empty object inherits defaults.
sh_better_ui.panel.theme.invalid: Invalid settings. Check the fields, format, and value ranges.
sh_better_ui.panel.theme.tooltip: Cycle and preview the library theme. Select Custom to edit materials and effects, then Apply to save.
sh_better_ui.panel.background_music.tool: Lights up the rainbow dots to the beat of system audio. Analysis stops when you leave this panel.
sh_better_ui.panel.background_music.susp: Turn off reduced motion and high contrast to enable the music pulse.
sh_better_ui.panel.motion.tooltip: Reduce transitions and animated feedback in SHBUI's default controls.
sh_better_ui.panel.hover_animation.toolt: Animate hover transitions and card lift. When disabled, hover feedback appears immediately. Reduce motion takes priority.
sh_better_ui.panel.press_animation.toolt: Animate button scale and release transitions. Press colors remain when disabled. Reduce motion takes priority.
sh_better_ui.panel.selection_pulse.toolt: Briefly emphasize newly selected buttons. Selection markers remain when disabled. Reduce motion takes priority.
sh_better_ui.panel.tooltip_delay.tooltip: Set the hover tooltip delay for SHBUI buttons, sliders, and scrollable tabs. Keyboard focus keeps native tooltip behavior.
sh_better_ui.panel.tab_wheel.tooltip: Use the wheel over scrollable tabs without changing the selection. Keyboard navigation remains available when disabled.
sh_better_ui.panel.tab_drag.tooltip: Drag the tab bar horizontally without switching pages. Press Esc to cancel and restore the previous position.
sh_better_ui.panel.tab_auto_reveal.toolt: Scroll the selected tab into view. Keyboard focus remains visible even when this is disabled.
sh_better_ui.panel.tab_scroll_step.toolt: Set GUI units per wheel notch. Fractional touchpad input accumulates proportionally.
sh_better_ui.control.tabs.usage: Use Left, Right, Home, or End to switch tabs. Press Enter or Space to select the focused tab, or Esc to cancel dragging.
sh_better_ui.panel.widget_blur.suspended: Control backdrop blur · Paused in high contrast

sh_better_ui.panel.reset.tooltip: Restore the default settings and shortcut in the draft.
sh_better_ui.panel.reset.undo.tooltip: Restore the draft from before the reset.
sh_better_ui.panel.apply.tooltip: Save these settings and apply them to SHBUI.

sh_better_ui.lyrics.config.title: Link Lyric Settings
sh_better_ui.lyrics.color.title: Font Color
sh_better_ui.lyrics.location.title: Lyrics Position
sh_better_ui.lyrics.location.hint: Drag the lyrics or use the arrow keys, then select Save.
sh_better_ui.lyrics.tip.lineCount: How many lyric lines to show at once
sh_better_ui.lyrics.tip.lineGap: Blank space between the main line and the lines below, in pixels
sh_better_ui.lyrics.tip.opacity: Overall opacity of the whole lyric block
sh_better_ui.lyrics.tip.lineScale: Font scale of the current line; 100% is the original size
sh_better_ui.lyrics.tip.maxWidth: Maximum lyric width as a fraction of the screen
sh_better_ui.lyrics.tip.transition: Duration of the transition between two lines
sh_better_ui.lyrics.tip.offset: Lyric time offset; positive values show lyrics earlier
sh_better_ui.lyrics.tip.weight: Stroke weight percentage; 0 means no extra weight
sh_better_ui.lyrics.tip.strokePx: Outline width. One pixel caps the contour on 9px glyphs; wider smears strokes together
sh_better_ui.lyrics.tip.strokeAlpha: Outline opacity. Separate from colour so changing density keeps your pick
sh_better_ui.lyrics.config.layout.toolti: Shape the lyrics occupy on screen. Arc and Ring do not scroll, so overlong lines are cut
sh_better_ui.lyrics.config.mixed.tooltip: Splits a line by glyph source, then slightly scales and re-baselines CJK glyphs to close the visual size gap with Latin. Off by default: turning it on moves every lyric containing CJK
sh_better_ui.lyrics.tip.mixedScale: CJK glyph scale relative to Latin; 100% is unscaled. At 9px, 96% trims roughly 0.18px on each side
sh_better_ui.lyrics.tip.anchorRatio: Where the lyric block sits vertically. 0% is bottom (default), 100% is top; the top collides with boss bars and the scoreboard, so drag it down a little for a clean spot
sh_better_ui.lyrics.tip.padX: Horizontal padding of the lyric backdrop, in pixels. It only affects the backdrop and drag area, not text position
sh_better_ui.lyrics.tip.mixedBaseline: Vertical correction for CJK glyphs; positive lifts. 0 means no correction - this value can only be tuned by eye in game
sh_better_ui.lyrics.gallery.layout: Cycle between stacked, arc and ring layouts.
